span.p:
storage is a CHOICE, not a fake. STORAGE_BACKEND=memory
builds real in-memory stores that run the same write-through
path as Postgres, and all three backends pass one contract
suite (D75). 'memory' does not mean 'no persistence layer' -
it means the durable record lives in this process.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the point of the shape: everything in the left column
is real logic, and every fake is at a PORT. Swapping one in is
a config change, so no phase is ever blocked on telephony,
a GPU or an API key.
